global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu, menma, and a pink-tinted naruto fish cake, garnished with green onions. Served in a white bowl on a black tray, the warm lighting highlights the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: Black tray with red rim, textured surface, rectangular shape, slightly raised edges, visible grain pattern.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, cradling thin noodles and garnishes in a smooth, inviting surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, irregularly shaped slice with a golden-brown, slightly wrinkled surface and visible marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow with green tips, showing fibrous texture and curved, segmented shape.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale yellow with pink swirl center, slightly textured surface, bite mark visible.
